# Independent whole-document approval

All staged entries, changed prose, complete long supplements, and unique short variants were read. Exact author spans replay to frozen staged entries. Additive reviewer edits retain all numeric/version tokens from staged prose and preserve ID/href/src attributes exactly. Full string-leaf hashes and edit ranges record original-to-approved retention; original guards are not rebased against live data.

Remaining apparent runnable examples are explicitly hypothetical models or verification protocols. Archived Spring code paths are Markdown labels, not separate Java files. Archive hashes/member maps preserve provenance. Historical compile/GC measurements remain attributed source claims and are not reproduced or certified.

Pinned NoteWeave code supports JdbcTemplate in the inspected repositories, the official SDK factory/embedding call and staged Kafka listeners. It does not establish all-provider implementation, individual authorship, current deployment settings or measured capacity. Numerical128MB/128MiB examples are retained with configuration provenance bounded. Internship and TencentDB claims require independent experience records.

Go1.23 map internals remain historical;1.25 CPU/GC and1.26 default Green Tea are version scoped. JDK21 GA G1 uses1–32MiB ergonomic versus1–512MiB explicit limits and strict greater-than-half object threshold. Other inherited references are not represented as newly fetched.

Actual compiled renderer functions were evaluated with only ancillary navigation dependencies stubbed: full QA answer remainders, authored leads, documents and supplements checked. No browser pixels, full build, JVM, Go, Spring or performance execution claimed. Static link checks report pre-existing missing destinations without rewriting them.
